row.title: A newborn system waited until 03:00 UTC to ask the directory to list it
row.body: BOOT-4 says every system is listed from its first deploy, but the seed's directory heartbeat only fired in the 03:00 UTC window, so the first live acceptance run (seed-launch 45709149770) passed six of seven layers and failed discovery for second-tenant. The heartbeat now registers from birth, hourly until listed, and keeps the directory's answer in directory_registration; bootaccept --run registers by a second route and names the directory's reason when it still refuses.
